newsitem.title: USA: Noble buys rig, sells two barge rigs.
newsitem.headline: Noble buys rig, sells two barge rigs.

text.p: Noble Drilling Corp said on Monday it acquired a jackup drilling rig and sold two posted barge rigs.

Noble bought the jackup drilling rig from Fairweather Offshore LP for $26.25 million. The rig, which is contracted to India's state oil company, is capable of working in up to 300 feet of water, the company said.
The company sold two posted barge rigs to an Energy Ventures Inc subsidiary for $32 million, consisting of $24.5 million cash and $7.5 million in drill pipe credit, Noble said.
Noble Drilling said the deal with Energy Ventures removes it from the inland drilling barge market and is consistent with its plans to focus on deepwater drilling.
